title.zh: 乡村和西部音乐的起源

summary.en: Two regional styles before the Nashville merger.
summary.zh: 纳什维尔合流前：东南乡村与西南西部。

body.en:
Before 1945, “country” and “western” were different regional products—Southeast/Appalachia vs Texas/Oklahoma/West Coast—not one marketing umbrella. The Blues Brothers gag (“both kinds”) is funny now because the merger already happened.

Country drew on white gospel. Ralph Peer’s 1920s Southern field sessions (*Fiddlin' John Carson*, Gid Tanner’s Skillet Lickers) captured pre-network local styles. Carter Family (*Can the Circle Be Unbroken*, 1935) show gospel harmony and Maybelle Carter’s bass-string melody + treble brush. Roy Acuff (*Great Speckled Bird*, 1936) ties lyric to scripture and brings early slide/Hawaiian approaches that feed later steel guitar.

Western music splits into Western swing (Bob Wills & His Texas Playboys—*New San Antonio Rose*, 1940; Crosby’s cover hit the pop chart, Wills’s own cut did not) and Hollywood cowboy songs (Gene Autry’s *Back in the Saddle Again*, Roy Rogers).

Before Nashville fused the business, Jimmie Rodgers (1927–33; died of TB at 36) was the first country star with a managed persona: Blue Yodeler and Singing Brakeman on the sheet-music covers—railroad costume as brand, not résumé. Hear *Blue Yodel* (1927); Lynyrd Skynyrd later covered the lineage. Yodel technique (chest/head flips) was the hook people copied.
body.zh:
1945 年前，Country 与 Western 是两种东西，分别流行于东南与西南。电影《The Blues Brothers》里那句「两种都做，乡村和西部」在今天像笑话，在 1945 年前却是事实。这类音乐曾被当成「乡巴佬」音乐，受众偏低收入、低学历的南部农村；二战与人口迁徙后，北方城市听众也跟上。

乡村音乐起源于东南与阿巴拉契亚，深受白人福音影响。Ralph Peer 20 年代带着便携录音机下南，录下广播网尚未抹平的地方音乐，早期包括 Fiddlin' John Carson、Gid Tanner and His Skillet Lickers。

两个关键名字：Carter Family——*Can the Circle Be Unbroken*（1935）里能听福音和声，以及 Maybelle Carter 标志性吉他：低音弦走旋律同时拨高音弦，影响深远。Roy Acuff——*Great Speckled Bird*（1936），歌词里「大斑点鸟」他解释为圣经，再一次指向福音。他从 1936 年起弹 slide / Hawaiian 式钢弦，1945 年后演变成乡村标志的 steel guitar。

西部音乐在德克萨斯、俄克拉何马与加州西海岸。一支是 Western swing：Bob Wills and His Texas Playboys，像大乐团碰上乡村提琴/铜管，*New San Antonio Rose*（1940）上过乡村榜，Bing Crosby 翻唱后上主流榜——Bob Wills 原版却没进主流榜。另一支是 Cowboy：Gene Autry 的 *Back In the Saddle Again*（1939），还有 Roy Rogers。

在乡村与西部尚未在纳什维尔合成一种产业风格之前，第一位巨星是 Jimmie Rodgers（活跃 1927–1933，36 岁死于肺结核）。他影响 Gene Autry、Ernest Tubb、Eddy Arnold 等，并刻意经营形象：乐谱上既是 Blue Yodeler，也是 Singing Brakeman——铁路工人人设是宣传，不是履历。推荐 *Blue Yodel*（1927）；Lynyrd Skynyrd 70 年代翻唱过。约德尔式胸声/头声快速切换是他的招牌。
